text: [71] catūhi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu apaṇṇakapaṭipadaṃ paṭipanno hoti yoni cassa āraddhā hoti āsavānaṃ khayāya katamehi catūhi idha bhikkhave bhikkhu sīlavā hoti bahussuto hoti āraddhaviriyo hoti paññavā hoti imehi kho bhikkhave catūhi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu apaṇṇakapaṭipadaṃ paṭipanno hoti yoni cassa āraddhā hoti āsavānaṃ khayāyāti .
